 Print Picture Credit: X Rajinikanth’s ‘Jailer 2’ continues to perform well at the box office even after completing three weeks in theatres. Released on October 15, the action drama collected Rs. 827 crore worldwide, making it the highest-grossing Tamil film of all time. On Sunday, the film saw a 15% rise in its India net collection compared to Saturday. ‘Jailer 2’ day 25 box office numbers
 According to trade analyst Sacnilk, ‘Jailer 2’ collected Rs. 1.15 crore net in India on Day 25 across 657 shows. The Tamil version contributed Rs. 90 lakh from 382 shows, while the Telugu version earned Rs. 12 lakh from 111 shows. The Hindi version added Rs. 10 lakh from 136 shows, and the Kannada version collected Rs. 3 lakh from 28 shows. Watch Dhols, Crackers and Milk Abhishek: Rajinikanth Fans Celebrate Jailer 2 as Box Office Numbers Roll In With its latest collections, ‘Jailer 2’ has taken its total India net collection to Rs. 470.40 crore, while its India gross stands at Rs. 550.15 crore. The film collected another Rs. 10 lakh from overseas markets on Day 25, taking its total overseas gross to Rs. 276.85 crore. Its worldwide gross collection has now reached Rs. 827 crore. An estimated 82,036 tickets were sold for the film on Day 25, taking its total ticket sales across the run to 32,100,536. ‘Jailer 2’ occupancy
 ‘Jailer 2’ recorded an overall theatre occupancy of 84.32% on Sunday. The film is enjoying a sustained audience interest during the Diwali festive period. Morning shows registered 38.36%, while afternoon screenings recorded 72.36%. Evening occupancy stood at 77.36%, followed by 62.82% during night shows. About ‘Jailer 2’
 Directed by Nelson Dilipkumar , ‘Jailer 2’ is the sequel to Rajinikanth’s 2023 blockbuster ‘Jailer’. The film follows retired jailer Tiger Muthuvel Pandian, whose peaceful life is disrupted by a new threat from the criminal underworld. He is forced to return to his ruthless ways to protect his family and preserve his legacy. Cast of ‘Jailer 2’
 Apart from Rajinikanth, the film features Vidya Balan, Suraj Venjaramoodu, S. J. Suryah, Vijay Sethupathi, Mithun Chakraborty and Jackie Shroff in important roles. Malayalam superstar Mohanlal, Hrithik Roshan and Shiva Rajkumar make special appearances. Poll Vote & Share your view
